en: A monochrome vintage image of a low, sprawling bungalow-style house with a broad porch supported by heavy rustic columns set on a stone base. The house is surrounded by lush landscaping, including ornamental grasses, potted palms, and climbing vines along the porch. A neatly manicured lawn stretches across the foreground. In the upper right corner a red printed number "6711." appears, suggesting a catalog or series number.
